cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
  project(r33_mapping LANGUAGES C CXX)
  set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
  set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
  set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
  enable_testing()
endif()

# Required real numerical libraries. This target never compiles a substitute
# cloud/plane/grid implementation when a target SDK is unavailable.
find_package(PCL 1.10 REQUIRED COMPONENTS common filters features segmentation search sample_consensus kdtree)
if(R33_TARGET_LZ4_LIBRARY)
  if(NOT TARGET FLANN::FLANN)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Target LZ4 requires the PCL FLANN::FLANN imported target")
  endif()
  if(NOT EXISTS "${R33_TARGET_LZ4_LIBRARY}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Target LZ4 shared library is missing: ${R33_TARGET_LZ4_LIBRARY}")
  endif()
  # FLANN headers instantiate calls to LZ4 in their consumers as well.
  target_link_libraries(FLANN::FLANN INTERFACE "${R33_TARGET_LZ4_LIBRARY}")
endif()
find_package(Eigen3 REQUIRED)
find_package(OpenCV REQUIRED COMPONENTS core imgproc)
find_path(R33_RAPIDJSON_INCLUDE_DIR rapidjson/document.h REQUIRED)
add_library(r33_mapping_core STATIC
  "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/pointcloud/backend/src/mapping.cpp" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/fusion/backend/src/label_fusion.cpp" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/fusion/backend/src/detection_labels.cpp"
  "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/fusion/backend/src/config_labels.cpp" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/pointcloud/backend/src/ground_segmentation.cpp" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/fusion/backend/src/map_render.cpp"
  "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/pointcloud/vendor/src/pcl_common.cpp" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/pointcloud/vendor/src/patchworkpp.cpp")
target_include_directories(r33_mapping_core
  PUBLIC "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/pointcloud/backend/include"
  PRIVATE "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/pointcloud/backend/src" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/pointcloud/vendor/include" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/fusion/backend/include"
    ${R33_RAPIDJSON_INCLUDE_DIR})
target_include_directories(r33_mapping_core SYSTEM PRIVATE ${PCL_INCLUDE_DIRS} ${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_compile_definitions(r33_mapping_core PRIVATE PCL_NO_PRECOMPILE)
target_link_libraries(r33_mapping_core PUBLIC ${PCL_LIBRARIES} Eigen3::Eigen ${OpenCV_LIBS})

# These imported targets/variables belong to this directory's find_package
# scope. Generate their actual configuration-selected paths here, rather than
# asking the parent directory to rediscover a possibly different SDK version.
# Eigen and other INTERFACE libraries have no TARGET_FILE; their link edges
# are still traversed. Bare -l flags and unsupported generator expressions are
# deliberately left to the packager's exact DT_NEEDED resolver, not guessed.
function(_r33_mapping_visit_link_library entry guard)
  if(entry STREQUAL "" OR entry MATCHES "-NOTFOUND$")
    return()
  endif()
  if(entry MATCHES "^\\$<INSTALL_INTERFACE:.*>$")
    return()
  endif()
  if(entry MATCHES "^\\$<(LINK_ONLY|BUILD_INTERFACE|TARGET_NAME_IF_EXISTS):(.+)>$")
    _r33_mapping_visit_link_library("${CMAKE_MATCH_2}" "${guard}")
    return()
  endif()
  if(entry MATCHES "^\\$<(\\$<.*>):(.+)>$")
    set(_r33_condition "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}")
    set(_r33_conditional_entry "${CMAKE_MATCH_2}")
    if(guard)
      set(_r33_condition "$<AND:${guard},${_r33_condition}>")
    endif()
    _r33_mapping_visit_link_library("${_r33_conditional_entry}" "${_r33_condition}")
    return()
  endif()
  if(entry MATCHES "\\$<")
    return()
  endif()
  if(TARGET "${entry}")
    get_target_property(_r33_aliased "${entry}" ALIASED_TARGET)
    if(_r33_aliased)
      set(entry "${_r33_aliased}")
    endif()
    string(SHA256 _r33_visit_id "${entry}|${guard}")
    get_property(_r33_seen GLOBAL PROPERTY R33_MAPPING_LINK_VISITED)
    if(_r33_visit_id IN_LIST _r33_seen)
      return()
    endif()
    set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY R33_MAPPING_LINK_VISITED "${_r33_visit_id}")
    get_target_property(_r33_type "${entry}" TYPE)
    get_target_property(_r33_imported "${entry}" IMPORTED)
    if(_r33_imported AND _r33_type MATCHES "^(STATIC_LIBRARY|SHARED_LIBRARY|MODULE_LIBRARY|UNKNOWN_LIBRARY)$")
      set(_r33_file "$<TARGET_FILE:${entry}>")
      if(guard)
        set(_r33_file "$<${guard}:${_r33_file}>")
      endif()
      set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY R33_MAPPING_LINK_FILES "${_r33_file}")
    endif()
    foreach(_r33_property IN ITEMS INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES IMPORTED_LINK_INTERFACE_LIBRARIES)
      get_target_property(_r33_links "${entry}" "${_r33_property}")
      if(_r33_links)
        _r33_mapping_visit_link_list("${_r33_links}" "${guard}")
      endif()
    endforeach()
  elseif(IS_ABSOLUTE "${entry}" AND entry MATCHES "\\.(so(\\.[A-Za-z0-9_.+-]+)?|a|lib|dll)$")
    set(_r33_file "${entry}")
    if(guard)
      set(_r33_file "$<${guard}:${_r33_file}>")
    endif()
    set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY R33_MAPPING_LINK_FILES "${_r33_file}")
  endif()
endfunction()

function(_r33_mapping_visit_link_list libraries guard)
  set(_r33_keyword "general")
  foreach(_r33_library IN LISTS libraries)
    if(_r33_library MATCHES "^(optimized|debug|general)$")
      set(_r33_keyword "${_r33_library}")
      continue()
    endif()
    set(_r33_library_guard "${guard}")
    if(_r33_keyword STREQUAL "debug")
      set(_r33_keyword_guard "$<CONFIG:Debug>")
    elseif(_r33_keyword STREQUAL "optimized")
      set(_r33_keyword_guard "$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Debug>>")
    else()
      set(_r33_keyword_guard "")
    endif()
    if(_r33_keyword_guard AND guard)
      set(_r33_library_guard "$<AND:${guard},${_r33_keyword_guard}>")
    elseif(_r33_keyword_guard)
      set(_r33_library_guard "${_r33_keyword_guard}")
    endif()
    _r33_mapping_visit_link_library("${_r33_library}" "${_r33_library_guard}")
    set(_r33_keyword "general")
  endforeach()
endfunction()

set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY R33_MAPPING_LINK_VISITED "")
set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY R33_MAPPING_LINK_FILES "")
_r33_mapping_visit_link_list("${PCL_LIBRARIES};${OpenCV_LIBS};Eigen3::Eigen" "")
get_property(_r33_mapping_link_files GLOBAL PROPERTY R33_MAPPING_LINK_FILES)
list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES _r33_mapping_link_files)
string(JOIN "\n" _r33_mapping_link_content ${_r33_mapping_link_files})
set(_r33_mapping_link_content "# Genuine mapping imported targets; configuration-selected file paths\n${_r33_mapping_link_content}\n")
if(CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
  # Packaging builds Release. A single output cannot contain four different
  # configurations in a multi-config generator, so select Release explicitly.
  if("Release" IN_LIST CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
    set(_r33_mapping_manifest_config "Release")
  else()
    list(GET CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES 0 _r33_mapping_manifest_config)
  endif()
  file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/r33_mapping_linked.txt"
    CONTENT "${_r33_mapping_link_content}"
    CONDITION "$<CONFIG:${_r33_mapping_manifest_config}>")
else()
  file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/r33_mapping_linked.txt"
    CONTENT "${_r33_mapping_link_content}")
endif()

if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(r33_mapping_core PRIVATE /utf-8 /EHsc /fp:precise /bigobj)
else()
  target_compile_options(r33_mapping_core PRIVATE -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off)
endif()
option(R33_MAPPING_BUILD_TESTS "Build original numeric oracle and staged mapping tests" ON)
if(R33_MAPPING_BUILD_TESTS)
  add_executable(r33_mapping_tests "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/validation/sdk/mapping/tests/mapping_tests.cpp")
  target_link_libraries(r33_mapping_tests PRIVATE r33_mapping_core)
  target_include_directories(r33_mapping_tests PRIVATE "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/pointcloud/backend/src" "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/pointcloud/vendor/include" ${R33_RAPIDJSON_INCLUDE_DIR})
  target_include_directories(r33_mapping_tests SYSTEM PRIVATE ${PCL_INCLUDE_DIRS} ${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS})
  target_compile_definitions(r33_mapping_tests PRIVATE PCL_NO_PRECOMPILE)
  add_test(NAME r33_mapping_original_oracle COMMAND r33_mapping_tests)
endif()

install(DIRECTORY "${PERCEPTION_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/pointcloud/backend/include/" DESTINATION include COMPONENT SharedSDK)
